posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are the last unbeaten team standing at 5-0 with a league-best 788.44 points, and triciagloston's middling 5.5 career average finish is about to get a total rewrite.
posts.detail: Nobody else in this league is undefeated, and the 788.44 points-for gap over the field keeps growing. This isn't a hot streak anymore, it's a statement season.

posts.headline: Thicks dropped a game and suddenly the 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish I've been screaming about for 26 straight editions is the headline instead of the footnote.
posts.detail: One ring doesn't erase a .500 career mark, and now that the first loss is on the board at 4-1, every future slip gets measured against that championship pedigree Tyrique14 is supposed to be living up to.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner is still buried at 1-4 and a franchise with a league-best 1.5 average finish and 20-8 career record has officially become the biggest underachiever in Busters Anonymous history.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra built a resume of two straight finishes in the top two, and adambarner111 is currently sitting with the second-worst record in the league to show for it.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is 1-4 with a league-worst 490.18 points, and Pharaoh23's bottom-feeder pedigree of a 10 average finish is playing out exactly on schedule.
posts.detail: A career 6-8 record and a dead-last average finish already set the bar on the floor, and this roster is still finding ways to limbo under it.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT is 0-5 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is delivering the kind of biblical drought that makes you check if there's a plague clause in the league bylaws.
posts.detail: Zero wins, a middling career 13-14-1 mark now trending firmly toward worst-finish territory, and a guy who once drafted a defensive player first overall is out here searching for any gospel that explains a winless start.
